answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 16092 Country: United States of America Title: Assalam alaikum .... I am studying from a university in USA. But I got admission into another very good university. I did isteqara 7 times asking whether moving to the new university is good for me.I saw two dreams , one in which i saw money being lost and in another i saw snakes. So I wanted to know the meaning of this dream and is it better for me to move to this university. Question: Assalam alaikum .... I am studying from a university in USA. But I got admission into another very good university. I did isteqara 7 times asking whether moving to the new university is good for me.I saw two dreams , one in which i saw money being lost and in another i saw snakes. So I wanted to know the meaning of this dream and is it better for me to move to this university. Answer ID: 16092 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1781/D=264/L=1430) In istikharah it is not necessary that the correct aspect of the matter is shown in dream, even some dreams have reverse interpretations; therefore it is difficult to understand the indications of dream. You should see the tendency of your heart, you should opt for the aspect you to which you feel to be tended more submitting your trust in Allah. ما خاب من استخار one who performs istikharah he does not experience failure. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
